summary:
HP is the PC and printer brand at hp.com. The circle mark in the browser tab is the favicon for support and store pages on that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against hp.com. HTML came from https://www.hp.com/us-en/home.html (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 32x32 → https://www.hp.com/favicon.ico.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.hp.com/favicon.ico returned png (32×32, 696 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #0044dd comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-32x32-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-32x32-01.png at 32×32 (png, 696 bytes) from https://www.hp.com/favicon.ico.
